subject: Brightwell MAP — internal pre-kickoff alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Brightwell MAP — internal pre-kickoff alignment

Team —

Attached is the working MAP draft for Brightwell and a paired evaluation criteria doc. We have the external kickoff scheduled for Thu 2/18; this thread is to align internally before we present. High-level goals for this pre-kick: make sure roles are clear (owner for each action), confirm the evaluation milestones and timelines, and lock the close target (customer indicated end of March).

Key asks (please reply in-thread with short bullets):
- Marcus: validate the resource / technical milestones and whether we need an early PoC spike during week of 2/22.
- Rishi: confirm proposed pricing cadence in the MAP and whether we should surface the 3-month pilot discount in kickoff.
- Marissa: review stakeholder RACI and call out any missing reviewers or approvers on the customer side.
- Grace: ops/hosting constraints — can Brightwell's requirements be met with our Dedicated offering or do we need Private?

Attachments: MAP_Brightwell_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Evaluation_Criteria_v2.docx (scoring rubric), Stakeholder_RACI.csv

Quick notes I added in the map: we aim for an evaluation window of 3 weeks with two decision gates (feature-complete demo + data-security sign-off). Close target in MAP = 2027-03-31 (soft).

I'll consolidate comments tomorrow AM and produce a 'final for kickoff' deck.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: MAP_Brightwell_v1.2.xlsx - spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightwell MAP — internal pre-kickoff alignment

Soojin — quick read-through below. I left inline comments in the MAP spreadsheet (tab: Technical Milestones). Summary:
- Spike requirement: I agree on a light PoC during week of 2/22 but recommend limiting to a narrow test (100k tokens, synthetic dataset) so we don't consume reserved capacity. Owner: Marcus (engineering lead) + Brightwell infra contact (TBD).
- Integration milestone: move 'schema ingestion' earlier by 3 days; Brightwell indicated that their data team can provide a sample earlier.
- Risks: call out GPU memory/quantization compatibility for their long-context logs (we should add an explicit mitigation to the MAP).

Action items for me:
1) Create a short ops checklist for the PoC (resource estimate, data sanitize steps) — due 2/17 EOD.
2) Confirm Dedicated vs Private recommendation after ops risk sync with Grace.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP_Brightwell_v1.2.xlsx - comments added)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightwell MAP — internal pre-kickoff alignment

Thanks—I'll keep this short. Pricing/timeline notes:
- Pilot pricing: propose we lead with a 3-month trial priced at 60% of list for the pilot (call it 'Pilot Intro' in the MAP). If legal needs a special SOW, we can provide a short appendix.
- Payment terms: recommend 30 days net for pilot to remove friction.
- Timeline: If the customer is comfortable with a March 31 target, we need signed SOW by 3/01 to allow procurement + onboarding time.

For the kickoff ask: I volunteer to own the commercial/contract milestone and follow procurement at Brightwell. I will need the finalized MAP to create a clean SOW draft (I can have the first cut by 2/20).

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightwell MAP — internal pre-kickoff alignment

Team — small edits to RACI:
- Add Brightwell legal reviewer (Name: Claire Huang) as 'C' for contract review; add Brightwell security lead (internal) as 'A' for security sign-off. I've updated Stakeholder_RACI.csv with those rows.
- Recommend we mark 'Data Access Approval' as owner: Brightwell PM (they indicated this in discovery).

Other suggestion: in the Evaluation_Criteria doc, include a 'SLA acceptance' checkbox and a pass/fail flag for performance at 95th percentile latency. That will help avoid ambiguity at the decision gate.

I'll be at the kickoff and can run the RACI slide.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — pulling this together. Final notes before external kickoff on Thu 2/18 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent):
- Confirmed owners: PoC/ops = Marcus; Commercial/SOW = Rishi; RACI & customer comms = Marissa; Hosting recommendation = Grace (please confirm by 9am Thu).
- Deliverables I will bring to kickoff: 1-slide MAP summary, proposed timeline (MAP Milestones tab), and the evaluation rubric. Rishi — I'll share the latest MAP with your pricing notes at 9:30am Thu so you can present the commercial cadence.
- Internal pre-kick checklist
  * Marcus: Ops checklist in drive (linked) — due 2/17 EOD (please flag any blocker)
  * Marissa: Finalized RACI in shared folder — done
  * Grace: Hosting recommendation + short notes — confirm Thu 9am
  * Rishi: SOW first-cut ready by 2/20

Drive + prep deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3MAPDraft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2345678 (deal owner: rishi.malhotra)

If no major blockers this morning I will mark the MAP as 'kickoff-ready' and send the external pre-read to Brightwell.

-Sojo (Soojin)
